title: Vighnaharta Shree Siddhivinayak
desc: Manav Mehta is a successful industrialist whose personal life is in disarray. His parents leave home because of his uncourteous behavior. After problems at work, his car breaks down on the way to work, and he unintentionally visits the Siddhivinayak temple. This visit changes his life.

title: Lajja
desc: The Film follows four women from different backgrounds in India as they unite to fight against misogyny and violence in their society. Forced marriage, domestic abuse, and honor killings are just some of the struggles they face. Through their determination, they discover the strength of the human spirit, inspiring others to join their fight for justice. With a powerful cast and storyline, sheds light on important social issues and the fight for women's rights. Will these women succeed in creating a better future for themselves and future generations?

title: Shootout At Lokhandwala
desc: A film based on a real-life gun battle between the Mumbai police and gangsters in Mumbai Lokhandwala Complex in 1991. The movie follows the story of a notorious gangster, and his team who terrorize the city with their crimes. As the police close in on them, a bloody shootout ensues, leaving many dead on both sides. The film explores the complex dynamics between law enforcement and organized crime in Mumbai's underworld.

title: Fight Club
desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.

title: Pyar Ki Takkar (dub) (aranmanai Kaavalan -Tamil)
desc: A large family returns to an ancestral property (palace) to sell it off. Meanwhile they discover some supernatural elements in the palace.
